categories.main_business_segments: DAI-DAN CO., LTD. operates primarily in the facility construction industry, focusing on the design, supervision, and execution of air conditioning, sanitation, and electrical equipment construction projects. The company and its group entities are structured as a single business segment centered on facility construction, with additional activities in regenerative medicine equipment and contract manufacturing through a non-consolidated subsidiary.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced engineering in HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning), sanitation, and electrical systems, with a strong emphasis on energy efficiency, ZEB (net Zero Energy Building) technologies, and digital transformation (DX) such as BIM, 3D modeling, and AI-driven building management. It also develops proprietary solutions for cleanrooms, smart buildings, and regenerative medicine facilities, including air barrier technology and sustainable filter regeneration using supercritical CO2.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DAI-DAN serves a diverse range of customers, including major general contractors, private corporations, public sector clients, and industries such as manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, data centers, healthcare, and large-scale commercial and public facilities. Key clients include major construction firms like Obayashi Corporation and Shimizu Corporation, as well as companies in the semiconductor, life sciences, and infrastructure sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales, with a growing presence in Southeast Asia, particularly Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam. It has subsidiaries and affiliates in these regions, and recent expansion includes the acquisition of a controlling stake in a Singapore-based engineering firm.
categories.supply_chain_position: DAI-DAN operates as a downstream contractor in the construction supply chain, providing integrated engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services directly to end clients. It coordinates with upstream suppliers for materials and equipment and manages subcontractors for on-site execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing as a 'space value creation' company, promoting sustainability (carbon neutrality, ZEB), digital transformation (DX), and expanding overseas and regenerative medicine businesses. R&D focuses on energy-saving technologies, AI/IoT-enabled building management, material quality improvements, and solutions for decarbonization and disaster resilience. The company also invests in human capital and diversity as part of its long-term vision.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through contract-based construction projects, recognized over time according to project progress. The company also derives income from maintenance, equipment sales, and, to a lesser extent, recurring services such as facility management and regenerative medicine contract manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DAI-DAN is positioned as a leading specialist in facility construction within Japan, competing with other major engineering and construction firms such as Taikisha, Sanki Engineering, and Shinryo Corporation. It differentiates itself through technological innovation, sustainability initiatives, and a strong reputation for quality and reliability in complex, large-scale projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached ¥262.7 billion, with operating profit of ¥23.0 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥17.4 billion. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with sales and profits increasing significantly year-on-year, and aims for further expansion to ¥270 billion in sales and ¥24 billion in operating profit by FY2026. The workforce exceeds 2,400 employees, and the company maintains a robust balance sheet with a nearly 50% equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DAI-DAN emphasizes its ability to deliver safe, comfortable, and reliable spaces through advanced engineering, sustainability, and digital innovation. Its unique value lies in expertise in ZEB and energy-efficient solutions, integrated project management, and a commitment to ESG and customer-centric customization, enabling it to address complex client needs in high-specification environments.
